Release Date: February 2, 2005

For immediate release

The Committee decided today to keep its target for the federal funds rate at 2 percent. Output appears to be growing at a moderate pace.

The Committee perceives the risks to be balanced. Policy accommodation can be removed at a pace that is likely to be measured.

Voting for the FOMC monetary policy action were: Alice Example, Chair; Bob Sample, Vice Chair. Voting against the action was Dan Placeholder, who preferred a larger increase.
